skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the fundamental aspects of development planning in a market economy, including the nature, principles, and modern systems of development planning.
Analyze the factors influencing the selection of planning methods and the organization of development planning in a market economy.
Apply modern planning principles to develop and refine national, sectoral, and local development tools in the Vietnamese context.
Implement and monitor development plans based on analytical, synthesis, teamwork, and management skills.
Demonstrate professional integrity, responsibility, and ethical conduct in the implementation and evaluation of development plans.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and evaluate development plans.
Communicate effectively in group work, presentations, and discussions.
Work effectively in teams to develop and present development plans.
Identify and implement effective solutions to development planning challenges.
Demonstrate leadership in planning and executing development plans.
